## Level Contracts

| Level | Audience | Target duration  | Capture fidelity |
|-------|----------|------------------|------------------|
| L100  | New      | 4 to 6 minutes   | deck             |
| L200  | Guided   | 6 to 8 minutes   | deck             |
| L300  | Applied  | 8 to 10 minutes  | live             |
| L400  | Extend   | 10 to 12 minutes | live             |
